recognize_zh: 箭頭所指紅血球內有一個形狀不規則、帶紫色染色質點的滋養體（trophozoite），旁邊另一顆紅血球含散在的棕黑色瘧色素顆粒，符合間日瘧（P. vivax）變形蟲樣滋養體（amoeboid form）；但影像失焦、放大倍率受限。
features: Intraerythrocytic parasite (arrow) with irregular, ameboid-appearing blue cytoplasm and a magenta chromatin dot
Adjacent red cell containing scattered fine brown-black hemozoin pigment granules, consistent with a more mature trophozoite
Parasitized cells do not show clearly resolvable Schüffner dots due to focus and resolution
Background red cells without obvious multiple ring forms or banana-shaped gametocytes
Out-of-focus image with refractile debris/artifact limiting assessment of red cell enlargement
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows intraerythrocytic malarial parasites. The arrowed red cell contains a trophozoite with irregular, ameboid cytoplasm and a chromatin dot, and a neighboring red cell contains a trophozoite with scattered brown hemozoin pigment. Enlargement of infected red cells and Schüffner stippling cannot be reliably assessed because the image is out of focus. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax amoeboid trophozoites in the stated clinical context; species confirmation by thick/thin film review or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: P. ovale trophozoites are compact rather than ameboid and infect oval red cells with fimbriated edges and prominent James dots.
P. falciparum shows multiple small delicate rings, appliqué forms and crescent gametocytes in normal-sized red cells, with mature trophozoites rarely seen in peripheral blood.
P. malariae trophozoites form compact band shapes with coarse pigment in normal-sized or small red cells without stippling.

ddx.dx: Platelet overlying a red cell / stain precipitate
ddx.vs: A superimposed platelet lies in a different focal plane, lacks a distinct chromatin dot with cytoplasm and has no hemozoin pigment.
